resources.string: Android won\'t keep the microphone on in the background. Say Hey KAI on the voice screen.
Android won\'t keep the microphone on in the background. Hey KAI only listens while this screen is open. The microphone stays visible.
After you ask KAI to send a WhatsApp message, this taps WhatsApp\'s Send button once. It does not read other apps or tap anything else.
When you ask what is on your screen, KAI reads the visible text and controls once. It does not tap anything and does not send the screen to a server.
